fullPassage: Therefore, it’s advantageous to identify early on which ideas hold promise and which do not. Most organisations and teams strive to deliver outstanding ideas, products, and services that will resonate with customers and generate a strong reputation. ( ) Ideally, they aim to achieve this swiftly and outpace their competitors. ( ) However, in the process of developing products, plans, or applications, constraints such as time, budget, and personnel obviously come into play. ( ) The earlier this assessment occurs, the more quickly resources can be channelled in the right direction, diverting investment away from unviable concepts. ( ) The ‘Fail Fast’ philosophy seeks to expedite the detection of failures by utilising comprehensive testing and gradual development.
